dataset_name: Illumination at the Moon's South Pole, 2023 to 2030
region: Within 2 degrees of the lunar South Pole; south of 88 degrees south latitude
inputs: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter global terrain mapping from the LOLA laser altimeter
limitations: This is a modeled sunlight and shadow visualization, not live lunar weather or habitat telemetry.
It does not provide measured oxygen, water, food, crew consumption, or outpost battery values.
All game resource percentages and decision effects remain illustrative gameplay values.

additional_learning_sources.name: DONKI
additional_learning_sources.role: Space-weather event records for educational solar-event briefings
additional_learning_sources.limitation: Earth/near-Earth event records are not direct lunar-surface radiation measurements.

additional_learning_sources.name: RadLab
additional_learning_sources.role: Radiation telemetry from spaceflight instruments, including ISS records
additional_learning_sources.limitation: ISS measurements must not be presented as lunar-base exposure measurements.

additional_learning_sources.name: OSDR
additional_learning_sources.limitation: Research data are not live astronaut medical telemetry.

additional_learning_sources.name: Mars Trek
additional_learning_sources.role: Real Mars imagery and terrain exploration
additional_learning_sources.limitation: Mars data are not lunar terrain data.

additional_learning_sources.name: Moon Trek
additional_learning_sources.limitation: Use for lunar mapping context; distinguish map layers from current operational measurements.

additional_learning_sources.name: Canadian Space Agency Food Production Toolkit
additional_learning_sources.role: Educational activities about astronaut nutrition, crop selection, and growing food for future lunar missions
additional_learning_sources.limitation: Educational reference material; it does not provide measured greenhouse yields or real outpost food-supply values.

additional_learning_sources.name: Canadian Space Agency Space Farmer Mini-Greenhouse Experiment
additional_learning_sources.role: Youth activity about seed sprouting, plant needs, and observing a mini-greenhouse
additional_learning_sources.limitation: A classroom learning activity, not a validated lunar greenhouse design or measured crop-yield dataset.
